name: black-tight-dress-realistic-bathroom-selfie
image_purpose: bathroom mirror, black dress, and phone photography reference

prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-contrast bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark hair and natural skin texture, wearing a modest opaque black long-sleeve dress with a high or boat neckline and a delicate silver necklace.
prompt.composition_elements: Classic mirror selfie with slight hip shift but neutral posture, left hand holding a smartphone, ornate octagonal gold frame, mirror dust/water spots, dark wood door, neutral wall, and sink faucet visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct smartphone flash, sharp focus throughout, high dynamic range, subtle digital grain in shadows, raw social-media mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone-style photography, portrait 9:16, no artificial bokeh, accurate reflection, detailed wood and mirror texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with natural skin texture takes a raw bathroom mirror selfie in a modest opaque black long-sleeve dress with a high neckline and delicate silver necklace. Use an ornate octagonal gold mirror, dark wood door, neutral wall, sink faucet, mirror smudges, direct flash, sharp background, and subtle digital grain. No body-emphasis instructions or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, off-shoulder neckline, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized hip emphasis, nudity, distorted reflection, extra fingers, plastic skin, artificial bokeh, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
